task: Configure Eye-Comfort Design Tokens in index.css and overhaul CreateProjectPage into an ergonomic 2/3 + 1/3 split layout studio
summary: Eliminated light-mode eye strain and glare by configuring the soft slate/zinc design tokens (--background: 210 20% 98% [#F8FAFC], --card: 0 0% 100%, --border: 214 32% 91% [#E2E8F0], --muted: 210 20% 94%, --muted-foreground: 215 16% 47%, --primary: 221 83% 53%) while preserving deep charcoal slate tokens for dark mode. Overhauled CreateProjectPage.jsx into an ergonomic 2/3 + 1/3 responsive split layout integrating Write Proposal, Similarity Clearance (with Winnowing and Vector Cosine metrics), and Pitch Deck Builder (with 16:9 widescreen presentation canvas and PDF export), alongside a live Pre-Defense Clearance policy gauge and Title Ratification Rule sidebar. Created reusable Progress and Select UI primitives, preserving full test compatibility and passing the entire 6-point verification battery.
